items.period: Small seal / Shuowen seal-script style; Commons labels it Shuowen seal style, without dating the particular digital drawing.
items.tradition: Chinese small seal script (modern digital vector reconstruction)
items.caption: Modern vector reconstruction of 雨 in a Shuowen seal-script style, showing a later standardized rendering of the rain graph.
items.alt: A modern black-line vector drawing of the Chinese character 雨 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a sourced seal-style comparison point following the early variable forms described by the paleographic entry. It is explicitly a digital reconstruction, not an ancient artifact image.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication stated on the exact Commons file page; original file link was verified there.

limitations.text: Only a seal-style reconstruction is proposed. No ancient oracle-bone or bronze image is selected because the inspected Academia Sinica page did not expose a verified direct glyph image URL, and no artifact image was visually inspected.
